summary: Maps SOCIAL_AUTH_GOOGLE_OAUTH2_KEY, _SECRET, _SCOPE to gateway KEY, SECRET, SCOPE (plus REDIRECT_STATE true), Google organization and team maps to gateway maps, and explains MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH (Organization Admins Can Manage Users and Teams), which now exists in both gateway and controller and is imported from controller on upgrade.
questions: How do Google OAuth2 settings map to platform gateway?
Can organization admins create users and teams in AAP 2.6?
Is Organization Admins Can Manage Users and Teams migrated?
